methodology: Jevons elementary (matched-SKU geometric mean) + 10-category equal-weight upper aggregation; excl_promo removes SKUs flagged promo on base or current day; unit prices canonicalized (¥/100g, ¥/100ml, ¥/unit); base_date fixed. A category with no matched SKU on a given day is carried forward from its most recent observed relative; a category never observed since base_date is mean-imputed (dropped and reweighted). imputed_weight_share reports the basket weight not observed that day.
coverage_note: single store, Tokyo metro delivery area, mid-tier supermarket (Life). Not nationally representative.
license: observation data; derived aggregates only; see repo

gap.reading: 上流CGPI YoY +7.1% に対し、店頭は base比 +1.11%(25日)。窓が短く年率比較は不能。転嫁の到達度はcum_pct_since_baseで追う。
gap.caveat: 月次が2点貯まった時点でMoM年率のgap(maturing)に自動昇格する。

promo_absorption.reading: 特売が基調(excl)の上昇を店頭でどれだけ吸収/隠しているか。プラスが大きいほど特売が転嫁を覆い隠している（『補助金で物価が見えにくい』の民間・特売版）。
promo_absorption.caveat: 短窓では日次特売のオンオフでぶれる。方向の観測用。
